title: What is Journey Lab?
speech: Journey Lab uses AI personas to explore your app—and reveal how different users could experience it before launch.

title: One change affects many journeys
speech: One change can help one user and frustrate another. Find that difference while you can still fix it.

title: See the discrepancy
speech: In this booking app, quick booking takes Alex from eight actions to six. For Maya, seven becomes twelve. Same change. Very different experiences.

title: Success can hide friction
speech: Both complete the booking. A success metric would miss the extra work. Journey Lab makes that difference visible.

title: Give each perspective context
speech: Alex values speed. Maya has a strict budget. Meta’s Muse Wonder follows each persona’s goals and constraints through the working app, making choices as it goes.

title: Catch the price surprise
speech: Maya sees a room for two hundred twenty dollars. At review, the total is two eighty. Over budget. Now the team can see exactly where the trouble starts.

title: Catch the repeated work
speech: She changes rooms. Her meeting name disappears. She types it again. Journey Lab surfaces friction that completion alone would hide.

title: Go from reaction to evidence
speech: Choose a reaction. See the recorded screen and the action behind it. Your team gets a specific moment to investigate, with evidence it can inspect.

title: Turn feedback into a fix
speech: Muse Code turns those findings into a reviewable candidate: show the full price earlier, keep entered details, and preserve the quick path.

title: Stay in control of the change
speech: Inspect the actual patch and its checks. Review the candidate before approving it. The finding, the change, and the evidence stay connected.

title: Retest both perspectives
speech: Now retest both. Maya finds the two-hundred-forty-five-dollar option earlier. Twelve actions become six. Alex keeps his quick path. The prices are unchanged. The journey is better in these recorded sessions.

title: See the whole journey
speech: Compare the recordings and the full reaction arcs. See what improved and where friction remains. These simulated perspectives guide investigation and better questions for real users.

title: Explore different needs
speech: A parent on a phone. A first-time customer. Someone returning with different expectations. Explore the constraints your team might otherwise miss.

title: Find it before release
speech: Before launching a product or an update, compare who it could help and which journeys it could complicate. Give your team clearer priorities while there’s still time to act.

title: Explore. Improve. Retest.
speech: Built during this hackathon, Journey Lab connects Muse Wonder and Muse Code in one workflow: explore, understand, improve, and retest.

title: See the impact before you ship
speech: Journey Lab. One product. Many journeys. Find the differences. Improve the experience. See the impact before you ship.
